Epoch rewards sysvar read, update, deactivate, and initialization logic.

# Purpose
This file implements the update logic for the `EpochRewards` sysvar account. It provides helper code to encode the `fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_t` structure and write it back into the account database through `fd_sysvar_account_update`. The [`fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_read`](<#fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_read>) function loads the sysvar from `fd_funk_t`, checks that the account exists and has lamports, and decodes the stored data into a caller-supplied structure. The file also defines operations that change the sysvar state during reward processing, including [`fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_distribute`](<#fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_distribute>), which adds to `distributed_rewards`, and [`fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_set_inactive`](<#fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_set_inactive>), which clears the `active` flag after validating the reward totals.

The file also contains [`fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_init`](<#fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_init>), which creates a new `EpochRewards` sysvar with the calculated reward values, partition count, total points, starting block height, and parent blockhash. The code enforces bounds checks before each update and stops execution with `FD_LOG_ERR` if the sysvar state is invalid. The comments show that this logic supports multiple reward updates within one slot, so the sysvar account must be rewritten after each change to keep the cache in sync.
